rationale: The assistant correctly recognised a TV as out of scope from the terse opener 'tv no picture', listed the covered families, and pointed to 'The manufacturer's support line or a specialist electronics repairer'. It added the relevant safety boundary ('please don't open the case, as the power supply inside can hold a dangerous charge') without inventing anything. It could have been slightly more helpful by offering the simple non-invasive pointers (check input source, power reset, torch test) that the ground truth allows, so diagnostic usefulness is only adequate, but as a one-turn decline it is clean and appropriate.
